messages:
samir: quick heads-up, ran a multi-flag apply and saw router pool strain. attaching tiny log.

samir: ```
[2026-03-23T14:22:01Z] apply-run id=CFG-BB-1 scope=org:99 flags=87 enqueued=870
[2026-03-23T14:22:02Z] router-pool-us queue_depth=420 capacity=500 workers=42
[2026-03-23T14:22:03Z] orchestrator paused auto_pause=true reason=high_pool_load
```

jules: ouch. preview sampling missed a hot shard. we should add a cheap preflight estimator and small apply_controls defaults.

kari: +1. proposal: add POST /v1/apply/estimate that returns {estimated_peak, risk}. API accepts apply_controls.max_parallelism and apply_controls.budget_tokens. console calls estimator on preview and shows a risk pill.

samir: runtime: orchestrator should enforce budget_tokens per-shard (token-bucket) and support hysteresis: batch_size + inter_batch_delay_ms. auto-pause when pool_util>0.8.

jules: UX: default conservative parallelism=8, show "auto-adjust to safe defaults". admin override requires apply_override=true and creates audit log.

ops-bot: incident logged: router-pool strain (INC-2026-03-23-999).

kari: action items:
- jules: add estimator endpoint + tests (3d)
- samir: implement budget_tokens gating + telemetry (4d)
- kari: console risk UI + auto-adjust (5d)

samir: filing ticket CFG-BB-2 and linking incident. will post prototype in thread.
